stock.description: Fosun International Limited operates as a global conglomerate, concentrating its diverse activities within the health, lifestyle, wealth management, and advanced manufacturing sectors. Its reach extends across Mainland China, Portugal, and various international territories. The company's comprehensive business model is primarily organized into five distinct segments: Health: This division is dedicated to the research, development, production, distribution, and commercialization of pharmaceuticals, biopharmaceuticals, and other health-related products, complemented by medical and health management services. Happiness: Focused on consumer experiences, this segment manages and invests in businesses related to tourism, leisure, fashion, and broader lifestyle industries. Insurance: Encompasses both the operation of insurance services and strategic investments within the global insurance market. Asset Management: This segment specializes in asset management services and various market investment activities. Intelligent Manufacturing: Involves both direct operations and investment in advanced manufacturing processes, including the production of iron and steel ore. Furthermore, Fosun International engages in capital investment and management, real estate development, retail, and reinsurance. Its extensive operations also include the manufacturing and sale of iron and steel products, provision of banking and financial services, medical consultation, and digital solution delivery. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, Fosun International Limited is a subsidiary of Fosun Holdings Limited.
